validated_results.reason: The study evaluates single-nucleotide polymorphisms and gene expression in retinol metabolism pathway genes rather than any population-wide vitamin A intake or circulating retinol exposure estimate.

validated_results.title: The Association Between the Genetic VDR SNP c.907+75C>T and Prostate Cancer Risk Is Modified by Tanning Potential.
validated_results.reason: The reported associations are VDR SNP interactions with tanning potential and UV exposure rather than a population-wide vitamin D exposure effect on prostate cancer risk.

sample_size.excerpt: All men who underwent prostatic biopsy in the Danish PCa Registry (DaPCaR) and who had a serum vitamin D measurement during the period 2004 to 2010 (n = 4,065) were identified.

validated_results.title: Association of Prostate Cancer with Nuts, Seeds, Alcohol and Processed Meats: A Worldwide Population-Based Study.
validated_results.reason: Original ecological population-based analysis reporting an association between alcohol intake and prostate cancer incidence rates across 170 countries.

extraction.comparison_type: Per-unit increase in national alcohol intake in linear regression on prostate cancer incidence rate
extraction.design: Ecological study with univariable and multivariable linear regression
extraction.population: 170 countries with available data on prostate cancer rates and dietary factors

sample_size.excerpt: We conducted an ecological study including 170 countries, whose data on incidence, prevalence and mortality rates of prostate cancer, dietary factors, and potentially confounding factors were available and collected in May 2020.

effect_size.excerpt: Intake of alcohol was associated with increased incidence, prevalence and mortality rates of prostate cancer (β 1.8, P < 0.001; β 4.5, P < 0.001; β 0.4, P < 0.001; respectively).

p_value.excerpt: Consumption of processed meats was also associated with increased incidence and prevalence rates of prostate cancer (β 0.6, P = 0.003; β 2.8, P = 0.001; respectively).

comparison.excerpt: Univariable and multivariable linear regression analyses were used.

design.excerpt: We conducted an ecological study including 170 countries
